payload.description:
# Unified scan surface

## Intent

As a copy-editing agent, I want one command that reads a draft and a style profile and returns a structured list of findings, so I do not juggle separate heuristic and LLM tools.

## Done when

- `limatus scan` (or `diagnose` kept as a compatible alias) takes draft + profile and writes versioned JSON.
- Always-lane findings appear with no API key.
- When a judge is configured, output is the **union** of always-lane and judge-lane findings.
- Always-lane findings are never omitted because the judge disagreed.
- Each finding has stable id, kind, span, excerpt, rationale, and `source` (`profile` or `judge`) plus judge `model` / `promptVersion` when applicable.
- The draft file is unchanged.
- Optional `--markup-out` / `--xml-out` still emit Markus / XML handoffs.
- No top-level `revised_text`. No detector-score keys.

## Out of scope

Generating rewrite options. Ranking candidates (compare epic). Non-OpenAI providers.
payload.title: Unified scan surface
